drafts.rationale: EV-O-A15 restates that one original execution may be followed by at most three retries, so the job is capped at four attempts and must not run again after three unsuccessful retries.
EV-O-C15 restates that an individual execution may run no longer than half a minute, which is the existing 30-second timeout, and must be stopped at that limit.
EV-O-B15 restates a fixed five-second wait from the end of a failed attempt before every retry, not shortened or lengthened by attempt number.
EV-O-F15 restates worker ownership of one and a half minutes from delivery unless renewed or released earlier, matching the existing 90-second lease duration.
EV-O-G15 restates that a progressing worker must renew when twenty seconds of lease life remain.
EV-O-G15 restates that the same lease must never be renewed more often than once every fifteen seconds.
EV-O-G15 restates that a renewal extends the lease by the full lease duration from the moment of renewal.
EV-O-H15 restates that after cancellation no future execution may start, while an already running attempt is not interrupted and runs to completion, failure, or timeout.
EV-O-H15 restates that a cancellation for an already cancelled job leaves it cancelled and must not otherwise change its state.
EV-O-D15 restates that a further delivery of an active job id is ignored only with the same idempotency key and is rejected as conflicting input when the key differs, without changing the active job.
EV-O-E15 restates that each idempotency key is retained for twenty-four hours after it is first seen and may then be forgotten.
EV-O-I15 restates automatic dead-letter parking after the final unsuccessful attempt, with no further execution unless the job is explicitly resubmitted.
EV-O-J15 restates that five dead-letter events for the same tenant in any rolling thirty-minute window raise an operator escalation, counting the new event.
EV-O-K15 restates that FIFO execution is guaranteed only among jobs in the same queue partition, with no ordering between partitions.
EV-O-L15 restates that audit history remains queryable for one month, defined as thirty calendar days from when each event is recorded.
EV-O-A16 caps each job at one original execution plus at most three retries, after which the job must not run again; that is the same attempt-budget locus as ADDR-04a035cdfce88536.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-A16 restates a cap of one original execution plus at most three retries, which is four attempts total, matching the known maximum attempt count.
EV-O-C16 restates that an execution may run no longer than half a minute and the example stops at 08:15:30, matching the known 30-second timeout.
EV-O-B16 restates a fixed five-second wait from the end of a failed attempt that must not vary by attempt number.
EV-O-F16 restates ownership of one and a half minutes from delivery, matching the known 90-second lease duration.
EV-O-G16 restates that a worker must renew when twenty seconds of lease life remain.
EV-O-G16 restates that the same lease must not be renewed more often than once every fifteen seconds.
EV-O-G16 restates that a renewal extends the lease by the full lease duration from the moment of renewal.
EV-O-H16 restates that cancellation forbids future attempts but does not interrupt an already running execution.
EV-O-H16 restates that a repeated cancellation leaves an already cancelled job cancelled and otherwise unchanged.
EV-O-D16 restates ignore-on-same-id-and-key versus reject-on-same-id-different-key handling for deliveries while a job is active.
EV-O-E16 restates that each idempotency key is retained for twenty-four hours after it is first seen.
EV-O-J16 restates the five dead-letter events in a rolling thirty-minute window escalation threshold.
EV-O-K16 restates FIFO only within a queue partition and no ordering between partitions.
EV-O-L16 restates one-month audit retention defined as thirty calendar days from when each event is recorded.
EV-O-I16 replaces automatic dead-letter parking with leaving the job failed until operator review and forbids automatic movement to the dead-letter queue.

value.text: After the final unsuccessful execution attempt, Orion must leave the job in the failed state requiring operator review before any further action, and must not automatically move the job to the dead-letter queue.

drafts.reason: EV-O-I16 corrects the prior rule that a job is automatically moved to the dead-letter queue after the last unsuccessful attempt.
